crossRefs.note: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.
He shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age; for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is…

parallels.note: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
translations.bsb: The neighbor women said, “A son has been born to Naomi,” and they named him Obed. He became the father of Jesse, the father of David.
translations.kjv: And the women her neighbours gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
translations.asv: And the women her neighbors gave it a name, saying, There is a son born to Naomi; and they called his name Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
